_README: FROZEN GROUND-TRUTH LABELING SPEC for the THEIA E3 evaluation. Values transcribed directly from the DARPA TA5.1 Engagement 3 Ground Truth Report (Kudu Dynamics, May-2018), THEIA sections 3.3, 3.11, 4.6, 4.8. This is the ONLY place attack-vs-benign truth enters the pipeline; the tagger/detector never sees it. Keys mirror the CADETS spec so connector_stage2_theia.py loads it unchanged.
timezone_note: Report event logs are in US Eastern (UTC-4 in April 2018), same convention as the CADETS report. Windows below are converted to UTC by adding 4 hours. The THEIA target host appears on the enterprise net as 128.55.12.167; attacker infrastructure is the external 145.x/104.x/61.x/etc. addresses listed in c2_ips_corroborating.

_episode_provenance.2018-04-10 (Firefox backdoor, Drakon in-: Firefox 54.0.1 exploited via gatech.edu ad server; in-memory drakon, then dropped/executed as /home/admin/clean and /home/admin/profile with privilege-escalated execution; wrote /var/log/xdev. Eastern event log 13:41-14:55 -> UTC 17:41-18:55; window padded. Includes the 4.6 phishing-link episode (THEIA open email 13:42 Eastern) which overlaps this afternoon and has only browser/C2 host traces.
_episode_provenance.2018-04-12 (Browser extension, Drakon dr: Drakon written to disk from the pass-manager browser extension; acting process gtcache (Drakon APT); whoami/ps discovery; dropped xdev, wdev, /tmp/memtrace.so; micro-apt dropped as /var/log/mail with C2 to 149.52.198.23; injection into sshd failed. Eastern 12:44-13:26 -> UTC 16:44-17:26; padded.
_episode_provenance.2018-04-13 (Phishing e-mail w/ executabl: Malicious executable tcexec downloaded and run; FAILED on a missing QT library, so little host activity beyond the download/exec attempt. Eastern 13:50-14:04 -> UTC 17:50-18:04; padded.

ioc_rule: An event is a ground-truth attack IOC iff its timestamp is within an attack window AND (its acting process name is in implant_process_names, OR it is an outbound connection to an IP in c2_ips_corroborating, OR it writes/unlinks a file whose basename starts with an implant_file_basename). Window + identity come from the report (authority); independent of the detector's generic signatures. [Same rule as CADETS -- do not change.]
path_label_rule: A candidate path is ATTACK iff it contains >= 2 IOC events (frozen; sensitivity at >=3 reported); BENIGN iff 0 IOC events; EXCLUDED from the main run iff exactly 1. [Same rule as CADETS -- do not change.]
_scoping_note: Strongest host-level episodes are 2018-04-10 (3.3) and 2018-04-12 (3.11): real implants, file drops, discovery, and C2, so they form scoreable chains. The 2018-04-13 attachment (4.8) FAILED on the target, and the 4.6 phishing link is browser credential-harvest with minimal host provenance, so both may contribute few or no attack paths -- that is a true property of the data, not a bug. Run cadets_e3_inspect.py on the THEIA files first to see which run (ta1-theia-e3-official-1r/3/5m/6r) covers Apr 10 and Apr 12.
source: DARPA Transparent Computing E3 THEIA ground-truth report (Kudu Dynamics / TA5.1, May-2018), sections 3.3, 3.11, 4.6, 4.8.
